notes: Company background: midsize CX SaaS provider for SMB+enterprise contact centers; product bundles with helpdesk and bot orchestration.

Primary ask: replace legacy keyword search + Elasticsearch rerank with vector-based RAG for ticket deflection and agent assist. Tight latency SLOs for UI: 95th < 250ms end-to-end; rerank/top-5 quality must be near current precision for top answers.
Knowledge footprint: ~12M raw artifacts (kb articles, chat transcripts, support tickets) -> dedupe estimate ~8.5M documents to embed. Avg doc length 250 tokens; many short transcripts.
Traffic profile: baseline 60 qps, peak 320 qps (regional burst), median query complexity moderate. Many short queries from agents, critical low tail latency for agent UX.
POC setup (Feb 2026): small dedicated cluster, vector index sharded across 4 nodes, two-stage pipeline: ANN retrieve top-200 (HNSW) -> candidate rerank top-20 with cross-encoder style reranker.
Observed POC metrics: retrieval median 28ms, ANN 95th 60ms; reranker (cross-encoder on base model) median 140ms, 95th 260ms — pushed end-to-end above SLO for heavy queries.
Redwood experiment: ran reranker as a quantized 8-bit variant on Dedicated -> rerank median dropped to 72ms, 95th 110ms. Combined retrieval+rerank 95th ~170ms on Dedicated (meets SLO).
Quality: reranker improvement measured by P@5 + NDCG@5 vs baseline lexical was +22% for typical queries. Business wants consistent top-5 quality; A/B holdout planned across 2 weeks.
Cost sensitivity: target long-term cost per query (embed+retrieve+rerank) <$0.02 at 100 qps sustained. Current POC estimate with hosted cross-encoder was ~$0.045/q; Dedicated projection ~$0.013/q.
Indexing needs: incremental daily ingestion ~35k docs/day, retention policies for transcripts 24 months, legal requires selective redaction and residency for EU customers.
Security: must support SSO/SAML for admin console, KMS integration for model keys, audit logging for queries, and VPC peering for private control plane. Security team review in progress.
Operational asks: autoscaling for peak bursts, graceful fallback to cheaper reranker when capacity constrained, ability to pin model versions per environment.
Quotes from call: 'If the rerank step can't hit 100ms P95 we lose agent buy-in' (Head of Ops). 'We need deterministic unit economics to build pricing into our product' (CFO).
